name: Priya Nair
message: This tool helped me plan a 3,000 L rooftop system for my house. The payback calculator was spot on — I break even in 2.8 years, exactly as predicted. Monsoon season now feels like a resource, not a problem.

name: Suresh Iyer
message: Showed this to our apartment society. We used the demand vs supply chart to convince the committee. We installed a 10,000 L system for 24 flats and now save ₹45,000 a year on tanker costs. Tool is very practical.
